## Freelance & Personal Projects

### PhoneBot (2026) — https://phonebot.ie/
AI phone-answering service (AI receptionist) for Irish small businesses. Built from scratch.
Answers calls after hours and when staff can't pick up, holds a natural spoken conversation,
captures every enquiry, and sends the lead to WhatsApp, email and a spreadsheet — 24/7.
Tech: HTML/CSS/JS, Supabase (auth, DB, edge functions), Vapi (voice AI), Stripe (billing),
Resend (email), WhatsApp Cloud API. GDPR-compliant. Service area: Ireland.

### Liveloop (2026) — https://liveloop.space
Open-source social network where every post is an executable artifact
(games, infographics, chatbots, mini-tools) running inline in a sandboxed
9:16 feed. Scroll, play, save to a board, and remix any artifact. Built from scratch.
Tech: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Supabase, Tailwind CSS. MIT licensed.
Launch: created the "Stop Scrolling. Go Build Something." TikTok campaign — 4 videos
produced entirely with AI, targeting gamers, geeks, no-coders and content creators.
Campaign case: https://www.ofmediatech.com/cases/liveloop-campaign.html

### Dine With Me (2025) — https://dinecompetitions.com/en
Social dining platform with cooking competitions. Built from scratch.
Tech: HTML/CSS/JS, Supabase, Capacitor, Stripe. iOS & Android.

### Media Training AI (2024) — https://mediatraining.ai
AI-powered public speaking and media training platform.
Ran Google Ads campaigns targeting public speaking keywords.

### DWM Press / Signed with Faith (2025)
B2B sales: 382 leads, 5,060 emails, 213 calls, 37 visits, 2 sales closed.
